say:1:1061302001:1.text: You seem interested. Want to play a round of Century Quest?
say:1:1061302001:1.source_cn: 哟，你这么兴致勃勃，是也想来一局百物牌吧？
say:1:1061302001:1.male: You seem interested. Want to play a round of Century Quest?
say:1:1061302001:1.female: You seem interested. Want to play a round of Century Quest?

say:3:1061302002:1.text: Ha! No one can resist a round of Century Quest!
say:3:1061302002:1.source_cn: 哈哈，我就知道，没有人能拒绝百物牌的魅力！
say:3:1061302002:1.male: Ha! No one can resist a round of Century Quest!
say:3:1061302002:1.female: Ha! No one can resist a round of Century Quest!

say:4:1061302004:1.text: It's my turn to play, but since I'm nice and you're new. I'll let you have a go.
say:4:1061302004:1.source_cn: 算你运气好，这一局刚好轮到我来玩，看在你是新面孔的份上...
say:4:1061302004:1.male: It's my turn to play, but since I'm nice and you're new. I'll let you have a go.
say:4:1061302004:1.female: It's my turn to play, but since I'm nice and you're new. I'll let you have a go.

say:5:1061302005:1.text: None of the other guys are this nice.
say:5:1061302005:1.source_cn: 要是换成旁边这几个家伙，他们才不会让给你呢！
say:5:1061302005:1.male: None of the other guys are this nice.
say:5:1061302005:1.female: None of the other guys are this nice.

say:6:1061302006:1.text: Get ready, and don't let me down.
say:6:1061302006:1.source_cn: 做好准备，可别让我失望啊。
say:6:1061302006:1.male: Get ready, and don't let me down.
say:6:1061302006:1.female: Get ready, and don't let me down.

say:8:1061302003:1.text: Don't be shy. We're all here to play Century Quest!
say:8:1061302003:1.source_cn: 不用害羞，你看这里有这么多人呢，大家都是牌友嘛！
say:8:1061302003:1.male: Don't be shy. We're all here to play Century Quest!
say:8:1061302003:1.female: Don't be shy. We're all here to play Century Quest!

say:1:1061303001:1.text: I had no idea you played so well! That's crazy! Well, I guess... nothing is ever what it seems.
say:1:1061303001:1.source_cn: 你居然玩得这么好！完全看不出来……真是深藏不露呀。
say:1:1061303001:1.male: I had no idea you played so well! That's crazy! Well, I guess... nothing is ever what it seems.
say:1:1061303001:1.female: I had no idea you played so well! That's crazy! Well, I guess... nothing is ever what it seems.

say:2:1061303002:1.text: This was supposed to be my victory. But rules are rules: winner takes the pot.
say:2:1061303002:1.source_cn: 虽然这次机会是我故意让给你的，不过，胜利者的奖励还是理...
say:2:1061303002:1.male: This was supposed to be my victory. But rules are rules: winner takes the pot.
say:2:1061303002:1.female: This was supposed to be my victory. But rules are rules: winner takes the pot.

say:3:1061303003:1.text: I'm going to improve my skills, and so should you! I want to have a match with you in the future!
say:3:1061303003:1.source_cn: 我回去之后会好好精进技术的，你也不能懈怠！我还等着什么...

say:3:1061303003:1.female: I'm going to improve my skills, and so should you! I want to have a match with you in the future!
